name: Program Feedback Survey (Test)
description: Short feedback call about an NGO program. Dummy data only.

fields.label: Caller name
fields.question: May I know your name, please?

fields.label: District
fields.question: Which district do you live in?

fields.label: Preferred language
fields.question: Which language do you prefer: Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, or another language?

fields.label: Attended sessions
fields.question: Did you attend any of the program sessions?

fields.label: Reason not attended
fields.question: May I ask why you could not attend?

fields.label: Sessions attended
fields.question: How many sessions did you attend?

fields.label: Number of children
fields.question: How many children do you have?

fields.label: Children's ages
fields.question: What are the ages of your children?

fields.label: Satisfaction rating
fields.question: On a scale of 1 to 5, how satisfied are you with the program?

fields.label: Improvement suggestion
fields.question: Do you have any suggestion to improve the program?

fields.label: Consent to follow-up
fields.question: May we call you again later for a follow-up?
